system.description:
Core Ability — Dexterous: when you spend an action die on a Dexterity-based skill check, roll it twice and add both.

Skill points: 8 + Int modifier per level (×4 at Career Level 1). Vitality: 8 + Con modifier per level.

options.name: Tricky
options.description: Once per round, when an adjacent opponent misses you by 5 or more, immediately take a free Tire action against that opponent; you may substitute Acrobatics (Dex) for Resolve (Con).

system.description: Sneak gives synergy to Blend, and anyone researching your past or whereabouts takes three times as long.
